name: Cyborg Chat
source:
Yo, yo, yo!  

Welcome to Cyborg Chat!

Ready to chat with Dashaun?  

He's friendly and knowledgeable. 

He's here to support you as you consider a big decision.

Will you consider becoming a cyborg?


[From [url=https://lilalove.itch.io/cyborg-chat]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
哟、哟、哟！

欢迎来到《义体畅聊》！

准备好和达肖恩聊聊了吗？

他既友善热情，又博学多识。

在你权衡一项重大人生决定之际，他将在一旁为你提供支持。

你会考虑改造成为一名赛博格义体人吗？
